source: Prek Leap National School of Agriculture - "Banana Varieties Giving High Yield and Good Taste Quality" (ពូជចេកផ្តល់ទិន្នផលខ្ពស់ និងគុណភាពសជាតិ) variety trial report, January 2007
text:
This report from the Prek Leap National School of Agriculture documents a banana variety trial conducted in the school's own experimental garden (សួនពិសោធន៍), Phnom Penh, using a randomized complete block design (RCBD) with 3 blocks. The trial ran from planting on 26 August 2005 through final data collection on 26 June 2006 - covering roughly one banana life cycle from planting through fruit maturity, but not multiple fruiting cycles or sucker-generation succession.

The trial tested 26 total accessions: 23 varieties sourced from Belgium's international Musa germplasm collection (ITC codes, mostly FHIA-, GCTCV-, SH-, and TMBx- breeding lines plus older reference cultivars such as Gros Michel, Cachaco and Pisang Ceylan), alongside 3 Cambodian local check varieties - Chek Pong Moan, Chek Namva, and Chek Ambong. Each plot spaced plants 4 m x 3 m; soil at the trial site was reported as pH 6.2-6.8. The full accession list, with each numbered plot's reference code, is: 1) ITC.0312 Pisang Jari Buaya; 2) ITC.0504 FHIA-01; 3) ITC.0505 FHIA-02; 4) ITC.0506 FHIA-03; 5) ITC.0570 Williams (Bell, South Johnstone); 6) ITC.0643 Cachaco; 7) ITC.0712 Aacv Rose; 8) ITC.1122 Gros Michel; 9) ITC.1123 Yamyambi KH5; 10) ITC.1264 FHIA-17; 11) ITC.1265 FHIA-23; 12) ITC.1282 GCTCV-119; 13) ITC.1283 SH 3436-9; 14) ITC.1296 TMBx 5295-1; 15) ITC.1297 TMBx 5295-1 (second accession); 16) ITC.1307 SH-3640; 17) ITC.1319 FHIA-18; 18) ITC.1332 FHIA-21 (#68); 19) ITC.1344 CABP 39; 20) ITC.1418 FHIA-25; 21) ITC.1441 Pisang Ceylan; 22) ITC.1442 GCTCV-106; 23) ITC.1443 GCTCV-247; 24) local check Chek Pong Moan; 25) local check Chek Namva; 26) local check Chek Ambong.
